subject: Next steps & POC charter for Orion Analytics — proposed scope and success criteria
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & POC charter for Orion Analytics — proposed scope and success criteria

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Attached is a short POC charter that captures what we discussed and a lightweight evaluation plan so your team can share internally. Key points below so it's easy to scan.

High-level objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference as a low-latency, cost-predictable runtime for Orion's customer-facing summarization API (target: 95th percentile latency < 220ms for 512 tokens).

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
1) Integration: set up a test endpoint using your staging dataset (up to 10k requests/day simulated).
2) Latency & throughput: measure p95/p99, steady-state throughput and cold-start behavior.
3) Cost model: run a small workload to derive per-1k-token cost with suggested batching/quantization settings.
4) Quality guardrails: run a re-weighted BLEU/ROUGE check and a manual spot-check on 100 queries (you provide ground truth).

Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
- Performance: p95 latency < 220ms and p99 < 400ms for our configured 2-GPU flavor OR documented tradeoffs if those thresholds aren't met.
- Cost: projected < $0.30 per 1k output tokens at target throughput with at most 15% quality degradation vs baseline.
- Reliability: < 1% error rate for 10k simulated requests/day over 48h run.
- Acceptance: Product stakeholder sign-off after a short demo and a results deck.

Ownership and timeline:
- Redwood: Monica (AE) and Rishi (Solution Eng) — infra setup, benchmarks, and ops handover.
- Orion: Alex (Product lead) and your SRE (TBD) — dataset, ground-truth samples, and access to staging.
- Timeline: Kickoff next Monday (2026-04-13). Integration + baseline run (Day 1–4), tuning & quant runs (Day 5–10), final validation + review (Day 11–14).

Immediate asks for you to confirm this week:
- Confirm kickoff availability (we suggested Mon 4/13 10am PT).
- Share a representative sample of 100 ground-truth queries and the format (JSONL preferred).
- Point to staging endpoint credentials or a contact for SRE access.

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter-orion-v1.pdf (POC charter, 2 pages), sample-benchmark-results.csv (example output from a baseline run).

If that all looks good, I'll lock the calendar and loop in our infra lead for the kickoff.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

---
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for LLMs
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@orion-analytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & POC charter for Orion Analytics — proposed scope and success criteria

Monica — thanks for the concise recap and the charter. Quick answers and a couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Kickoff: Monday 4/13 10am PT works for Alex + our SRE (I looped him in separately). Please send calendar invite.
2) Dataset: we'll share 100 labeled examples by EOD Monday. JSONL with fields: id, prompt, expected_summary.
3) Latency target: the 220ms p95 is ambitious but reasonable — we care most about user-facing 95th percentile. If you need to open up the p95 window slightly during tuning, call it out in the report.
4) Metrics: in addition to BLEU/ROUGE, can you include a short set of human-readable failure categories (e.g., hallucination, truncation, incorrect entity)? That helps product triage.

Two asks from our side before kickoff: 
- Can you include an initial cost projection for production-scale (100k requests/day) with optimistic and conservative settings? A one-slide estimate is fine.
- We need a short runbook for rotating keys and handling rate-limit exceptions (for our SRE).

We're excited to see numbers. FYI I'll be out of office late Wednesday but reachable via Slack for urgent items.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager | Orion Analytics
alex.johnson@orion-analytics.com

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and the clarifications. Short update and attachments revised (version 1 includes the one-slide cost projection and the initial runbook stub).

- Monica (Redwood): send calendar invite for 4/13 10am PT + kickoff agenda (due: today EOD).
- Rishi (Redwood): prepare baseline benchmark script and the human-readable failure taxonomy; run an initial micro-benchmark (due: 4/15).
- Alex (Orion): share JSONL sample 100 examples (due: 4/13 EOD).
- Orion SRE: confirm staging credentials or provide an SRE contact for setup (due: 4/13).

I'll attach the updated charter (redwood-poc-charter-orion-v1.pdf) and a sample benchmark CSV so your team can preview columns we'll report. If anything in the success criteria needs to be softened for practical reasons, we'll note it explicitly in the results deck.

Next steps: I'll lock the kickoff and include a brief deck with success criteria, measurement plan, and a short runbook. Expect the calendar invite within the hour.

Thanks again — looking forward to running this with you.
